name: Your Claude Agent Layer: CRM, Database and Slack From One Webhook

parameters.content:
## Your Claude Agent Layer: CRM, Database and Slack From One Webhook

### How it works
- The first piece of your automation layer: one webhook in, one Claude agent, four tools.
- The agent finds the contact in HubSpot, reads their open orders and invoices from your database, updates HubSpot and hands anything it should not decide to Slack.
- Whatever sent the request gets the answer back on the same webhook call.
- Every run is logged; any failed step alerts Slack with the run link.
- Room to add next: the same tools opened to Claude Code as an MCP server, so it can call each tool directly.

### Setup
- Connect Anthropic, HubSpot, Supabase, Slack and Postgres, then fill in 0 - Config.
- Point your inbox, web form or internal tools at the step 1 URL.
- Set this workflow as its own error workflow so step 5 catches failures.
- Your part 9: tested on your real past requests, then a written doc of every tool and prompt.

### What I need from you
- Which CRM, database and chat tool you run today, if not HubSpot, Supabase and Slack.
- The credit or discount limit the agent may approve on its own.
- Twenty real past customer and team requests to test against.

## 1 - CLAUDE AGENT AND ITS CRM, DATABASE AND SLACK TOOLS

Your parts 1 to 4 and 6. A customer or team request, or a Claude Code task, hits the webhook. The Claude agent finds the contact in HubSpot, reads their records, updates HubSpot and hands off to Slack.

options.systemMessage:
You are the operations agent for a business. Requests come to you from customers (email or the web form) and from the team (internal tools or Claude Code). Your job: understand what is needed, check the facts with your tools, keep HubSpot current, hand anything you must not decide to the team in Slack, and write the reply.

Always in this order: 1) HubSpot - Find the Contact, by the sender's email. 2) Database - Look Up Their Orders and Invoices, by the same email. Answer order and invoice questions only from what the database returns: order status, scheduled date, invoice number, amount, due date and paid date. Never guess a date or promise one the records do not show. 3) HubSpot - Update the Contact with the topic and whether an issue is still open. 4) Slack - Hand It to the Team only when a person must decide: any credit or discount above the approval limit you are given, a billing dispute, a legal threat, a request to cancel an account, an upset customer, or a request you cannot match to any record.

topic is one of: order_status, invoice_question, billing_dispute, account_change, service_request, sales_inquiry, other. If the email matches no HubSpot contact, still look up records; if both come back empty, ask for the order or invoice number in the reply and set needs_person to false. If the request is empty or unreadable, set topic to other and needs_person to true.

The reply is 2 to 4 short sentences in a warm, plain voice, signed with the business name you are given. When a person must decide, the reply says the team is checking and will answer today; it never promises a credit.

nodes.name: 2 - Claude Agent Reads It and Picks Its Tools
nodes.notes: An agent, not a fixed script: an order question and a billing dispute take different tools.

parameters.toolDescription: Find the contact in HubSpot by email. Call first, once per request. Returns the contact id, name, company, lifecycle stage, last request topic and whether an issue is open.

values.name: email
values.description: The sender's email exactly as it arrived

nodes.name: HubSpot - Find the Contact
nodes.notes: Reads your CRM first, so the agent knows who it is talking to.

parameters.toolDescription: Look up the contact's five most recent orders and their invoices in the database, by email. Returns order number, status, scheduled date, invoice number, amount, due date and paid date.

nodes.name: Database - Look Up Their Orders and Invoices
nodes.notes: The answer comes from your data, never from the model's guess.

parameters.toolDescription: Update the HubSpot contact after you know the topic. Call once, only when Find the Contact returned a contact id.

values.name: contact_id
values.description: The HubSpot contact id from Find the Contact

values.name: topic
values.description: The topic you chose for this request

values.name: open_issue
values.description: true when the team still has to act, else false

values.name: order_number
values.description: The order the request is about, or an empty string

parameters.toolDescription: Post a hand-off to the team's Slack channel when a person must decide. Call at most once per request, last.

values.name: handoff
values.description: Contact name, company and email, order and invoice numbers with status, what they want, why a person must decide, and the reply draft

nodes.name: Slack - Hand It to the Team
nodes.notes: Credits over your limit, disputes and anything touchy go to a person, with the facts attached.
